## Products
- [Panel Air Conditioner](https://www.adhunikpowertech.com/panel-air-conditioners): A Panel Air Conditioner is a specialized industrial cooling unit designed specifically to manage heat within sealed electrical panels, control cabinets, and other enclosures housing sensitive electronic components. By actively removing heat generated during operation, these units prevent overheating, ensuring the reliability and longevity of critical equipment like PLCs, VFDs, CNC controls, and servers. They are essential thermal management tools in various applications – from industrial automation and manufacturing floors requiring CNC panel cooling or VFD panel cooling to data centers and telecommunication shelters – providing vital temperature control where standard air conditioning is impractical or insufficient.
- [Electrical Control Panel](https://www.adhunikpowertech.com/electrical-panels): Adhunik Powertech designs, fabricates, and tests heavy-duty LT panels, Motor Control Centers (MCC), Power Control Centers (PCC), and smart HVAC control panels. Engineered with Tier-1 switchgear (Schneider, L&T, Siemens) and thermally derated for harsh Northern India ambient conditions. Trusted by top industrial leaders.
